# РУСАЛЕН

> РУСАЛЕН — международный центр интегративной психологии, психосоматики и исследований сознания. Образование, наука и технологии для профессиональных психологов.

## Key facts
- Brand: РУСАЛЕН
- Domain: https://русален.рф (https://xn--80akrjlgn.xn--p1ai), mirror https://rusalen.center
- Language: Russian
- Audience: practicing psychologists, researchers, students, partners
- Primary CTA: consultation and contact forms on the website

## Pages
- / — overview of the center
- /about — who we are: /about/team, /about/mission, /about/news, /about/vacancies, /about/documents
- /science — research: /science/directions, /science/labs, /science/publications, /science/conferences, /science/international
- /education — fundamental education, professional retraining, advanced training, publishing: /education/fundamental, /education/retraining, /education/qualification, /education/publishing
- /library — PsyPedia, media library
- /psymedia — PsyMedia
- /psytorg — PsyTorg
- /psypay — PsyPay
- /psytech — PsyTech: /psytech/accelerator, /psytech/crowdfunding, /psytech/fund
- /psyty — Psyty
- /psyvent — Psyvent events
- /forum — professional forum
- /contacts — contacts and request form
- /живица/ — ЖИВИЦА, a digital platform for psychological support, crisis response and social adaptation of veterans and people with PTSD
